# Recipelog / 레시피로그

> A free, local-only recipe vault. Title, photo, prep/cook time, tags, notes,
> ingredients and ordered steps in one place. Paste a public recipe URL to pull
> ingredients and steps (schema.org/Recipe); when a site blocks that, paste or
> type them in. Scale servings, keep a shopping list, back up to JSON.
> No account, no ads, no paywall.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://recipelog.try-dabble.com/
Recipes and photos stay in this browser on this device. No accounts, no
uploads, no server storage, no ads, no in-app purchases. The only server-side
work is the optional URL extraction, which fetches the page you pasted and
returns the recipe data without storing anything.

This is NOT a recipe catalog, a meal planner with a subscription, or an
Instagram / TikTok downloader. Videos are never scraped: paste the caption and
keep a screenshot as the photo.

## Pages

- [Home](https://recipelog.try-dabble.com/): The vault
- [Privacy](https://recipelog.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://recipelog.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/en/guides/recipelog): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Manual entry: title, photo (compressed on device), prep / cook / total minutes, base servings, tags, notes, ingredients, steps, source URL
- URL extract: POST /api/extract reads schema.org/Recipe JSON-LD or microdata; blocked / paywalled sites (NYT, AllRecipes, ...) return a clear fallback to paste or manual entry
- Search across title, tags, notes and ingredients
- Servings control scales ingredients that start with a number; free-text lines stay as written
- Cook mode: one step at a time with a simple timer
- Shopping list merged from any recipes, tick items off, copy as text
- JSON backup export / import including photos (fail-case: no login, so no login wipe)
- Text size A / A+ / A++
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
